description: This file defines a class SandboxFsPathGuard for managing sandbox filesystem path safety, including path validation, boundary checks, and resolving paths within sandbox mounts. It includes types for path safety options, checks, and sandbox entries, and methods for path resolution and validation.

classes.name: SandboxFsPathGuard
classes.description: A class providing methods to enforce path safety within sandboxed filesystem mounts, including path validation, boundary checks, and path resolution.

methods.name: assertPathChecks
methods.description: Validates multiple path safety checks sequentially.

methods.name: assertPathSafety
methods.description: Performs safety validation on a specific path with given options.

methods.name: openReadableFile
methods.description: Opens a file at a sandbox path with boundary checks, throwing an error if it fails.

methods.name: resolveRequiredMount
methods.description: Resolves the filesystem mount for a given container path, throwing an error if not found.

methods.name: finalizePinnedEntry
methods.description: Creates a pinned sandbox entry object, ensuring the path does not escape allowed mounts.

methods.name: assertGuardedPathSafety
methods.description: Checks if a guarded path is safe, including directory existence and write permissions.

methods.name: openBoundaryWithinRequiredMount
methods.description: Opens a boundary file within the required mount, performing boundary checks.

methods.name: resolvePinnedEntry
methods.description: Resolves a sandbox path to a pinned sandbox entry.

methods.name: resolveAnchoredSandboxEntry
methods.description: Resolves a sandbox path to an anchored sandbox entry with canonical parent path.

methods.name: resolveAnchoredPinnedEntry
methods.description: Resolves a sandbox path to an anchored and pinned sandbox entry.

methods.name: resolvePinnedDirectoryEntry
methods.description: Resolves a sandbox directory entry relative to its mount.

methods.name: pathIsExistingDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a host path is an existing directory.

methods.name: resolveMountByContainerPath
methods.description: Finds the filesystem mount corresponding to a container path.

methods.name: resolveCanonicalContainerPath
methods.description: Resolves the canonical path of a container, following symlinks if allowed.
